INVALID_BACKUP: Backup content, references or integrity validation failed. Check the package and version; no records were imported. Inspect the local diagnostic before retrying.
INVALID_ENGINE_MANIFEST: The manifest is invalid or incompatible. Extract the Evidra Windows x64 package again and select engine-manifest.json.
ENGINE_NOT_CHOSEN: Choose engine-manifest.json in the extracted engine folder.
ENGINE_NOT_RUNNING: The engine is stopped. Verify its package and authorize startup.
MISSING_ENTRYPOINT: The package does not contain evidra-engine.exe. Extract the complete ZIP and keep all files together.
PAYLOAD_HASH_MISMATCH: A file differs from the manifest. Check SHA256SUMS.txt and extract the complete package again.
PAYLOAD_FILE_SET_MISMATCH: Engine files are missing or extra files were added. Extract the package into a new folder.
PAYLOAD_CHANGED: The package changed after verification. Verify the files and review the new fingerprint before authorizing it.
INVALID_CONNECTION_RECEIPT: The engine returned an incompatible port, profile or protocol. Use the package corresponding to this plugin version.
PROTOCOL_MISMATCH: The engine protocol is incompatible. Use both artifacts from the same Evidra distribution.
ACL_ERROR: Private permissions could not be verified. Use a local folder belonging to your account and inspect the engine diagnostic.
UNSAFE_NATIVE_PATH: The path contains a forbidden link or redirect. Extract the package into a regular local folder.
NATIVE_COMMAND_FAILED: Local path or permission verification failed. Inspect the native diagnostic and use a local folder belonging to your account.
ENGINE_EXITED: The engine exited during startup. Inspect the local diagnostic, permissions and package integrity.
HEARTBEAT_FAILED: The engine connection expired or failed. Reopen the workspace and check its state before restarting.
PROVIDER_HTTP_ERROR: The service rejected the request. Check the selected adapter, endpoint address and model name or availability. The HTTP error alone does not identify which setting caused the failure.
PROVIDER_TRANSPORT_ERROR: The service could not be reached. Check that it is running and that its configured address is correct. Review the operation state before retrying.
PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: The service did not respond within the time limit. Check its status and review the operation state before retrying.
